spellbook.finance/limitations: Creation requires a seller-selected name and explicit baseline multiplier and floor.
Creation does not activate the profile, pin it to a channel, publish a listing or trigger repricing.
Only seller-approved fields are accepted; repair, deletion and default generation are unavailable.

description: Create one seller pricing profile from a seller-selected name and explicit baseline multiplier and floor, with optional dollar offset and ordinary channel overrides. Returns saved profile and pin readback. It does not activate, publish or reprice.

valueBands.description: Optional ordinary market-value bands for this channel.

floor.description: Seller minimum price in USD for this value band. Omit to inherit the profile floor.

label.description: Seller label for this ordinary market-value band. Omit when unlabeled.

marketOffsetUsd.description: Seller dollar adjustment after the market multiplier. Omit for no adjustment.

maxUsd.description: Exclusive upper market value in USD. Omit for no upper bound.

minUsd.description: Inclusive lower market value in USD. Required.

mult.description: Seller multiplier for this value band. Required.

channelOverrides.description: Seller-approved overrides by marketplace channel. Omit when none are needed.

floor.description: Explicit baseline floor in USD. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profile_create
